description: Candlestick, OHLC and range charts for Microsoft Power BI, for any measure over time, with the indicators calculated inside the visual. Who it's for Finance and treasury analysts tracking prices. Retail and operations teams tracking a day's opening, closing, highest and lowest figures. Engineers and energy teams watching sensor peaks or market prices per hour. The problem it solves Indicators have to be written in DAX and maintained when the date range changes. Volume or RSI on a separate visual doesn't line up with the price axis. Long series get thinned and lose the real high or low, and broken rows draw nonsense candles. What you get Five chart types: candlestick, OHLC, Heikin-Ashi, line and area on one engine. Ten indicators: SMA, EMA, WMA, Bollinger, VWAP, RSI, MACD, ATR, volatility and returns, plus support and resistance. Panes: a volume pane and up to five indicator panes under the price, on one time axis. Navigation: zoom, pan and a slider that never filter the report; trading-day or continuous axis. Formatting: colour candles by a field, reference lines, annotations, second axis, small multiples. Big data: grouped by pixel column, keeping first, highest, lowest and last, so 25,000 rows stay truthful. Data check: flags rows where High and Low don't fit Open and Close. Also: Table and Insight views, export to CSV, Excel and PDF or copy to the clipboard, keyboard…
